technical.summary: GS shows strong short-term bullish confluence with overbought conditions and new highs, but lacks long-term trend confirmation and momentum divergences suggest caution on swing entry.

fundamental.summary: GS shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 68 days.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for GS; congressional purchases are modest and dated (62-87 days old), market fear/greed is neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (347), and recent CPI event create hostile environment for financials despite 68-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term technical confluence (RSI overbought, three white soldiers, new 20-day highs, supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) with price near support (311.97) offers tactical entry for mean-reversion bounce.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis-level at 347, unfavourable macro score of 1), fundamentals are absent (score 3, zero insider activity, high earnings risk), momentum divergences signal stalling, and price is below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA with weak volume support (0.9 ratio).

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows short-term overbought confluence near support, but macro environment is severely hostile with inverted yield curve and crisis-level VIX making financials structurally unfavourable.
decision.primary_risk: Macro deterioration (VIX 347, inverted yield curve) will likely override technical bounce; earnings in 68 days adds event risk; momentum divergences suggest stalling strength.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish macro override despite bullish technicals
